article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Democratic Republic of the Congo: International efforts face significant community challenges
article.articleSummary: As of June 24, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has resulted in 1,118 confirmed cases and 291 deaths, with a case fatality rate of 26%. The outbreak, primarily affecting Ituri province, has prompted the World Health Organization (WHO) to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Currently, 408 patients are hospitalized, and 122 recoveries have been reported. Community distrust and misinformation hinder control efforts, with only 77.1% of identified contacts successfully traced. The U.S. government is seeking over $1.4 billion in emergency funding to enhance response efforts. France has confirmed its first case linked to the DRC outbreak, involving a humanitarian doctor who tested positive after returning from the region. This case has triggered emergency protocols in France, including strict monitoring of contacts and enhanced surveillance for aid workers. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, with no approved vaccines or treatments available.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ：国際的な努力が地域社会の重大な課題に直面

triage.notes: WHOによる国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済み。Bundibugyo株による流行。フランスでの輸入症例確認により国際的拡大が既に開始。米国が14億ドル以上の緊急資金要請。地域社会の不信とニセ情報が対応を阻害（接触者追跡成功率77.1%）。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Democratic Republic of the Congo: International response escalates amid severe outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of June 25, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has resulted in 1,118 confirmed cases and 291 deaths, with a case fatality rate of approximately 26%. The outbreak, primarily affecting Ituri province, has seen a concerning increase in fatalities, including 14 new deaths reported in the last 24 hours. The World Health Organization (WHO) has declared this situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, marking it as the fastest-growing outbreak in history. Challenges such as violence against response teams, inadequate treatment facilities, and unsafe burial practices are exacerbating the crisis. An imported case in France involving a humanitarian doctor who recently worked in the DRC has led to immediate isolation and contact tracing for five individuals. The outbreak is attributed to the Bundibugyo strain, which lacks a licensed vaccine or specific treatment, complicating response efforts. Neighboring Uganda has also reported 782 confirmed cases and 178 deaths, highlighting the regional impact of the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：深刻な流行の中で国際的対応が拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準5つすべてに該当。WHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言した確認済みエボラ流行であり、複数国への拡大、高い死亡率、国際的な対応が必要な重大な感染症危機。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーが明示的にDRCでのエボラ流行を主題としており、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、1,118確認症例、291死亡、Bundibugyo株（ワクチン未開発）、複数州での流行（Ituri州が主要）、ウガンダへの越境拡大、フランスでの輸入症例が記載されている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。この情報は複数の公開衛生脅威基準を満たす明確なシグナルであり、即座にフルRRAに進める必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in India: Community efforts bolster prevention amid ongoing outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of June 24, 2026, India is facing a notable dengue outbreak, particularly in Kerala, where 159 new cases have been reported, contributing to a total of 13,747 fever cases this year, including 7 dengue-related deaths. Palakkad district has recorded the highest number of confirmed cases at 47. Pune has reported 315 suspected dengue cases from January to June, with 33 confirmed, including 31 in June. In Delhi, 347 dengue cases have been confirmed as of June 20, with no fatalities. The monsoon season has intensified the situation, as Aedes mosquitoes thrive in stagnant water. Community participation is vital, with local governments urging residents to combat mosquito breeding through awareness campaigns. A network of 35 sentinel surveillance hospitals is operational, and real-time case reporting is mandated. Civic agencies have intensified vector-control efforts, conducting over 1.81 crore household inspections and issuing 38,500 notices for breeding violations. In Gurugram, health officials have activated preventive measures, reporting four dengue cases and launching anti-larvae campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: インド：デング熱流行の拡大に伴い、コミュニティが予防対策を強化

triage.notes: デング熱は蚊媒介性疾患として季節性が強く、モンスーン時期の拡大が予想される。2026年6月24日時点で、ケーラ州を中心に複数州（ケーラ州、マハラシュトラ州、デリー、ハリヤナ州）で確認症例が報告されており、地理的広がりが示唆されている。死亡例（ケーラ州で7例、デリーで0例）があり、重症度の確認が必要。サーベイランスと防疫対策が既に実施されている。

article.articleSummary: As of June 24, 2026, India has reported 241 chikungunya cases this year, with 165 confirmed in June, leading to six fatalities. The monsoon season has exacerbated mosquito breeding, particularly in Kerala, where Kozhikode has recorded 57 cases, followed by Wayanad with 22 and Thrissur with 12. Health authorities have identified ongoing transmission in four districts and are urging the public to maintain hygiene and seek medical attention for fever symptoms. In Delhi, 19 chikungunya cases have been reported as of June 20, alongside 347 dengue and 87 malaria cases, with no deaths from these diseases. In response to rising concerns, Delhi's health officials have ramped up preparedness measures, including enhanced surveillance and public awareness campaigns. A network of 35 sentinel surveillance hospitals is monitoring cases, and mosquito-control efforts have been intensified. Citizens are encouraged to eliminate standing water and use mosquito repellents to mitigate risks. Additionally, Meenachil taluk in Kerala is experiencing a spread of viral fever, including chikungunya, overwhelming local healthcare facilities.

triage.notes: 2026年6月24日時点でインド全国241件のチクングニア熱確定症例（6月のみで165件）、死亡6件が報告されている。ケーララ州とデリーで主に集中。モンスーン時期による蚊の媒介能力増加が指摘されており、Kozhikode地区で57件、Wayanad地区で22件、Thrissur地区で12件などの多地点での流行が確認されている。デリー保健局が35カ所の感染症監視病院ネットワークを構築し、対策を強化している。

article.articleHeadline: African Swine Fever in Vietnam: Intensified measures to control ongoing outbreaks
article.articleSummary: As of June 2026, Vietnam is grappling with a significant outbreak of African Swine Fever (ASF), particularly in Dong Nai Province, where over 1,900 pigs have been culled following confirmed cases. The outbreak began with the deaths of 27 pigs and symptoms in 355 others, prompting immediate action from local authorities. The Central Veterinary Diagnostics and Testing Center confirmed ASF's presence, leading to strict disinfection protocols and enhanced surveillance measures. Investigations revealed that poor housing conditions and disease vectors, such as flies, contributed to the outbreak. In Can Tho, an additional 113 pigs were culled due to ASF. Dong Nai, being Vietnam's largest pig producer, is under increased scrutiny to prevent further transmission, with local officials urged to enforce biosecurity measures and closely monitor livestock movement. Authorities emphasize the need for thorough decontamination of infected areas and strict oversight of livestock farming and transport to mitigate the ongoing crisis.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのアフリカ豚コレラ：継続中の発生を管理するための強化措置
triage.triage_reason: ASFは動物健康上の重要な疾患であり、ベトナムでの大規模発生が確認されているが、ヒト-ヒト感染はなく国際的な公衆衛生緊急事態としてのリスクは限定的。動物保健および地域経済への影響で注視が必要。
triage.notes: ASFは人間に感染しない動物疾患であるため、IHR Annex2の公衆衛生への深刻な影響基準は適用されない。ただし、ベトナムが世界有数の豚生産国（Dong Nai省が最大）であることから、動物保健上の重要な発生であり、畜産物の国際取引制限のリスクがある。継続的な発生と複数地域への拡大（Dong Nai、Can Tho）を示しており、経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis in Philippines: Increased cases linked to rainy season exposure
article.articleSummary: From January 4 to June 6, 2026, the Philippines reported 2,177 cases of leptospirosis, marking a 6% increase from 2,046 cases during the same period in 2025. The majority of affected individuals are farmers and those exposed to floodwaters, particularly during the rainy season. Symptoms typically manifest 1–2 weeks post-exposure, including fever, chills, severe headaches, and muscle pain. The Department of Health (DOH) has established Leptospirosis Fast Lanes in hospitals to improve early detection and treatment. Preventive measures recommended by the DOH include avoiding floodwater, wearing protective gear, and seeking medical attention if symptoms arise. Doxycycline is available for at-risk individuals, but self-medication is discouraged to prevent complications such as kidney failure. Notably, there were 62 deaths reported from January 4 to March 14, 2026, a significant decrease of 46% from 115 deaths in the same timeframe in 2025, indicating a need for continued awareness and preventive actions among high-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンのレプトスピラ症：雨季の曝露に関連した症例増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。フィリピンにおける明確な流行トレンド（前年比6%増加、2,177症例、62死亡）と、雨季関連の環境的リスク継続が示されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づきフィリピンでの発生を確認。複数地域（マニラ首都圏、ビコル、ダバオ地域）での流行拡大が示されている。雨季との関連性が明確であり、農民と洪水曝露者が主要な患者層。死亡率が前年比で46%低下した点は改善傾向を示すが、依然として重大な公衆衛生課題として継続対応が必要。DOHによる対応体制（Fast Lanes設置、予防啓発）が既に実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis in India: Innovative strategies to enhance detection and care
article.articleSummary: Maharashtra has reported 6,111 new tuberculosis (TB) cases in the first 35 days of the 100-Day TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan campaign. An AI assessment identified 11,091 villages as high-risk for TB, prompting intensified screening in regions like Nagpur and Yavatmal. Recent statistics show Latur recorded 729 new TB cases from January to April 2026, while Ahilyanagar reported 4,493 cases and 92 deaths in 2025, with an additional 1,846 new cases and 10 deaths from January to May 2026. The National TB Elimination Programme is deploying 917 advanced diagnostic tools, including AI handheld X-ray machines, to improve detection. In Mumbai, pulmonary TB cases fluctuated with 29,962 cases in 2023, 16,649 in 2024, and 21,135 in 2025, highlighting ongoing urban management challenges. India accounts for 27% of the global TB burden, with over 315,000 deaths in 2023. The government aims to eliminate TB by 2025, supported by a patient-centered framework that addresses social determinants and enhances community involvement.

triage.headline_ja: インドにおける結核：検出とケアを強化するための革新的戦略
triage.triage_reason: 結核は対象国インドで既知・継続的な疾患であり、公開された研究論文に基づく報告である。IHR基準に該当するほどの異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められず、DISMISS相当だが、インド国内での大規模スクリーニング活動と政府プログラムの進行中状況が報告されているため、経過観察対象として位置づけは妥当。
triage.notes: 結核はインドにおいて既知の公衆衛生課題であり、新規イベント検出ではなく進行中の100日間TB撲滅キャンペーンに関する学術報告である。WPROスクリーニング基準で『長期曝露』『流行しやすさ』に該当するが、IHR基準を満たさないため、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）の優先度は低い。ただし政府の大規模スクリーニング活動と複数地域での症例増減動向が報告されているため、引き続き監視対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Smallpox in India: Kerala faces dual outbreaks amid health challenges
article.articleSummary: Kerala's Health Department is responding to a smallpox outbreak with 22 confirmed cases and 2 fatalities reported. Enhanced surveillance measures have been implemented, requiring daily updates from private hospitals to ensure accurate tracking of infectious diseases. The state is also dealing with a dengue fever outbreak, which has seen 159 confirmed cases and 295 individuals seeking treatment for similar symptoms. Palakkad district has the highest incidence of dengue, with additional deaths reported in Malappuram and Palakkad. The situation is further complicated by confirmed deaths from influenza A(H1N1) and suspected smallpox fatalities in Kollam. Overall, Kerala has recorded 197 infectious disease deaths this year, with smallpox accounting for 65 of these fatalities. Other significant contributors include amoebic meningitis, Acute Encephalitis Syndrome (AES), and Shigella infections. The Health Department emphasizes the need for comprehensive monitoring and collaboration between public and private sectors to effectively manage these overlapping public health challenges.

article.articleSummary: Kerala's Health Department is enhancing measures to combat the Nipah virus amid ongoing health challenges. triage.headline_ja: インド：ニパーウイルス ケララ州がウイルス感染症の蔓延抑制のため対策を強化

triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケララ州を中心とする複数地域でのニパーウイルス流行を示唆。患者の人工呼吸器装着、多数の接触者隔離監視（4例の非常に高リスク、14例の高リスク、75例の低リスク）が報告されている。同時にデング熱159例確認、痘瘡22例と死亡2例も記載されており、公衆衛生危機の様相を呈している。配信日時は2026年6月24日（未来日付）であるが、イベント情報の妥当性に基づき評価を実施した。

article.articleHeadline: Measles in Vietnam: Incomplete vaccinations fuel ongoing community transmission
article.articleSummary: From January 1 to June 10, 2026, Vietnam reported 740 measles cases, with an average of 30 new admissions weekly at the National Pediatric Hospital. The outbreak is largely driven by incomplete vaccinations among children, emphasizing the critical need for herd immunity, which requires at least 95% vaccination coverage. Many affected children had not completed their vaccination schedules, which include the MVVAC, MR, MMR, and MMRV vaccines. Despite vaccination campaigns in 2024 and 2025, delays and missed doses continue to hinder progress. Ongoing transmission is particularly noted in crowded healthcare facilities in the northern region. In Hanoi, the local health authority reported 14 new cases in the last week alone, contributing to a total of 304 cases across 101 wards/communes in 2026. The Ministry of Health urges parents to report any exposure history within 21 days of hospital visits to assist in risk assessment and infection control, while vaccination clinics remain prepared to administer vaccines safely.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの麻疹：不完全な予防接種が継続的なコミュニティ感染を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性・国際拡大リスク）、かつWPRO基準3つ以上該当（異常性・重症度・長期曝露）。継続的なコミュニティ感染と公衆衛生対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 2026年1月1日～6月10日で740例報告、ハノイで304例（101の区/村）。予防接種履歴不完全が主要因。医療施設内での継続的なコミュニティ感染が継続中。ベトナムは対象国として該当。

article.articleSummary: As of June 25, 2026, Kerala is facing a significant health crisis, with over 10,000 daily hospital visits for fever and 1,630 confirmed dengue cases, resulting in 7 deaths this month. article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Indonesia: Climate factors exacerbate health challenges nationwide
article.articleSummary: As of May 2026, Indonesia has reported 39,672 dengue cases and 105 fatalities, with West Java being the most affected region. The Health Ministry is urging heightened vigilance and preventive measures, while the government intensifies dengue control efforts through public education and the Mosquito Nest Eradication Campaign (PSN) as part of the 3M Plus program. By mid-June 2026, dengue fever, along with typhoid fever and tuberculosis, continues to pose significant health challenges. Allianz Indonesia reported 1,686 dengue claims totaling over Rp21.5 billion, highlighting the financial burden of treatment. In Klaten Regency, dengue cases have drastically declined to 100 cases and one death as of week 21 in 2026, down from 319 cases and three deaths last year, thanks to public awareness and community efforts.

article.articleHeadline: Influenza in China: Current trends and preventive measures highlighted
article.articleSummary: As of June 24, 2026, influenza activity in China remains low, with influenza B as the predominant strain. However, there is a significant increase in rhinovirus infections, particularly affecting children in Changsha, Hunan Province. Symptoms include nasal congestion, runny nose, and cough, prompting health officials to caution against self-medication due to the absence of specific antiviral treatments for rhinovirus. Complications such as otitis media and bronchitis are particularly concerning for infants and immunocompromised children. Public health recommendations emphasize the importance of prevention through regular handwashing, avoiding crowded spaces, and ensuring proper hydration. Surveillance data indicates that rhinovirus positivity is highest among outpatient influenza-like illness cases and hospitalized severe cases, especially in northern provinces. Other respiratory viruses, including parainfluenza and human metapneumovirus, show fluctuating trends, while SARS-CoV-2 positivity remains low. Parents are advised to seek medical attention for persistent symptoms and to manage mild cases with home care, hydration, and good hygiene practices.

article.articleHeadline: Syphilis in China: Awareness needed for atypical symptoms and transmission

The report underscores the importance of recognizing syphilis as a potential cause of unusual symptoms, particularly in individuals engaging in high-risk sexual behavior. While the case did not indicate any outbreaks or imported cases, it emphasizes the need for increased awareness, safe sex practices, and routine screening for high-risk populations to prevent further transmission.

Notably, children under 10 years account for approximately 68% of cases, with 928 infections, including 420 infants. The region has recorded 14 child fatalities, alongside deaths in older populations, particularly those aged 60 and above. Influenza A has been confirmed in 109 cases, contributing to 18 deaths. The onset of winter, characterized by dry air and reduced ventilation, is expected to heighten the risk of respiratory infections, including Influenza A and RSV. Health authorities are emphasizing vaccination against influenza and COVID-19, alongside pneumococcal vaccines, to mitigate severe outcomes. Preventive measures such as maintaining good ventilation and hand hygiene are also being promoted as the cold front approaches, potentially increasing transmission rates.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのインフルエンザA：冬が近づく中、小児死亡例がアラームを鳴らす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準4つ該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。小児を含む大規模集団での死亡多数、季節的増幅リスク、国家レベルの対応が求められている。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月24日時点のブラジル全国の呼吸器疾患危機を報告している。SRAG 70,000超件の報告、確認死亡102件（うちインフルエンザA由来18件）、小児死亡14件が記録されている。冬季（6月〜8月）の乾燥空気と換気低下により感染拡大リスク高い。インフルエンザAはサマリーで明示され、大規模流行の警告となっている。対象国リストではブラジル（3469034）のみが該当する。

article.articleHeadline: African Swine Fever in Philippines: Efforts to protect hog industry amid ongoing challenges
article.articleSummary: African Swine Fever (ASF) was confirmed in Negros Occidental on June 23, 2026, prompting Cebu to enhance seaport and border controls to safeguard its P15-billion hog industry, which currently reports no active ASF cases. The Cebu Provincial Veterinary Office is implementing strict measures at ports linked to Negros Island, requiring transporters to present valid shipping permits, animal health certificates, and negative ASF test results for all live animals entering Cebu. A province-wide hog surveillance and testing program is underway, involving 16 local government units, aiming for official ‘ASF-free’ status from the Bureau of Animal Industry. Meanwhile, the first ASF vaccine, AVAC live from Vietnam, is expected to hit the Philippine market in Q3 2026, following certification under Republic Act 12308. Despite ongoing challenges, including active ASF cases in seven provinces and concerns during the rainy season, industry stakeholders remain optimistic about stabilizing the hog sector as vaccination efforts progress.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンのアフリカ豚熱：継続的な課題の中での養豚産業保護への取り組み
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンの複数州（ネグロス・オクシデンタル含む7州）でASFが確認され、国家的な防疫対応が進行中。動物疾病であるが食料安全保障への影響（P15億の産業）、ワクチン導入段階、地域的な拡大リスクが認識される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはASF確認がネグロス・オクシデンタルで報告され、セブ州が防疫強化、7州でのASF活動例を記載。動物疾病で人間への直接的健康脅威ではないが、地域の食料安全保障・経済への著しい影響と、ベトナム産ワクチン導入という地域の対応状況が注目される。

article.articleHeadline: Foot And Mouth Disease in China: Schools close amid significant case counts
article.articleSummary: In May, Guangdong Province reported 27,849 cases of Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD), nearing a total of 30,000 for the month, marking the first annual peak coinciding with increased enterovirus activity. Shenzhen has been particularly impacted, leading to a 10-day suspension of classes in affected schools to curb further transmission. Students are required to stay home until June 29, with strict re-admission criteria based on symptom resolution and medical clearance. The majority of cases involve young children, especially those under five, with the highest risk in children under three. The Guangdong CDC has raised concerns over rising transmission rates, urging health authorities to maintain vigilance as summer progresses. HFMD spreads through contact with secretions, contaminated objects, and inhalation of droplets, with symptoms including rashes, fever, and poor appetite. While most recover within a week, severe cases can occur, necessitating continued monitoring and preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: 中国での手足口病：重大な症例数の中で学校が閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニングでも複数基準該当。学校閉鎖を伴う大規模流行で社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 手足口病（HFMD）は小児の一般的な感染症だが、月間27,849例は顕著な流行を示唆。特に5歳未満の小児に多く、学校閉鎖など公衆衛生対応が実施されている。エンテロウイルス活動の増加が背景にある。香港のニュースソース（hk.on.cc）だが、記事主題は広東省・深圳での流行であり、中国に分類。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza in Brazil: Vaccination campaign intensifies amid ongoing fatalities
article.articleSummary: In 2026, Campinas, Brazil has reported a total of 202 cases of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) related to influenza, with 15 fatalities, including two recent deaths of unvaccinated individuals with comorbidities. The previous year, 2025, saw 561 SRAG cases and 69 deaths, predominantly among the unvaccinated. To address the outbreak, a vaccination campaign was launched on March 28, 2026, administering 291,891 doses to date. The vaccine is available to all individuals aged six months and older at 69 health centers and the Divino Salvador Church in Cambuí, with no appointment necessary. It protects against influenza A (H1N1 and H3N2) and B. Vaccination coverage among priority groups includes 54.40% for the elderly (121,699 doses) and 41.60% for children aged 6 months to under 6 years (28,424 doses). Health authorities emphasize preventive measures such as hand hygiene, proper ventilation, hydration, and mask-wearing when symptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおけるインフルエンザ：継続的な死亡の中、予防接種キャンペーンが強化される
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでインフルエンザによる複数の死亡例（2026年に15件、前年2025年に69件）が報告されており、IHR基準「異常/予想外」および「重症度」に該当する。ワクチン接種キャンペーン展開中であり公開情報がある。
triage.notes: 2025年から継続しているインフルエンザ流行であり、2026年は死亡数は減少しているものの報告されている。ワクチン未接種者が被害者の多くを占めており、予防接種キャンペーンが進行中。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Typhoid in Indonesia: Healthcare challenges amid fluctuating weather conditions
article.articleSummary: As of June 24, 2026, Nene Mallomo Regional General Hospital in Sidrap is facing a notable increase in patients with severe flu-like symptoms, suspected to be typhoid fever. This surge is attributed to recent unstable weather patterns affecting both children and adults. Healthcare workers are performing vital sign checks and blood tests to confirm infections, with treatment protocols including antipyretics and IV fluids, while antibiotics are reserved for confirmed cases. Public health advisories emphasize the importance of seeking medical attention for fevers lasting more than 2-3 days and maintaining proper hydration. Additionally, by mid-June 2026, health claims data reveal that typhoid fever remains a significant health concern, with 1,534 claims reported, reflecting ongoing medical care demands. The average inpatient costs for typhoid cases have increased by 66% from 2020 to 2025, highlighting the financial burden of tropical diseases in Indonesia. Health officials continue to advocate for prevention and early diagnosis to mitigate rising healthcare costs.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの腸チフス：気象条件の変動の中での医療課題
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで腸チフスの患者数が顕著に増加しており、IHR基準のうち「異常性・予期性」と「公衆衛生への影響」に該当。また、WPRO基準でも重症度（入院患者の増加）、流行性（急速な患者増加）、管理可能性（医療費増加による負担）に該当し、複数の基準を満たすため。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアのシダラップ地域の病院における腸チフス患者の著しい増加を報告。2026年6月時点で1,534件の医療請求が報告されており、2020年から2025年にかけて平均入院費用が66%増加している。気象条件の不安定性が患者増加の原因と指摘されている。地域的な高い管理負荷と公衆衛生上の関心が認められる。

article.articleHeadline: Avian Influenza in Vietnam: Local response to poultry outbreak and vaccination efforts
article.articleSummary: In June 2026, an avian influenza A/H5N1 outbreak was confirmed in Đồng Tháp Province, Vietnam, affecting a family farm with 630 unvaccinated French Siamese ducks. Initial signs of infection were observed on June 5, with laboratory confirmation of 420 infected ducks by June 11. In response, local authorities swiftly culled the remaining 405 birds and implemented extensive cleaning and disinfection protocols, providing 500 liters of disinfectant to the outbreak site. This incident marks the only recorded A/H5N1 case in the province for the year. To prevent further spread, health authorities are monitoring individuals exposed to the infected poultry and are planning free vaccination campaigns for poultry in the affected and neighboring areas, urging farmers to vaccinate their flocks to mitigate future risks.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの鳥インフルエンザ：家禽アウトブレイクへの地域的対応とワクチン接種の取り組み
triage.triage_reason: H5N1は既知の重大な人獣共通感染症であり、異常性・重症度基準に該当するが、本事例は動物限定（人への感染報告なし）で対象国内の局地的な管理状況が示されており、IHR2つ以上の該当が確実でない。続報による人感染確認の有無を監視する必要がある。
triage.notes: H5N1の動物間アウトブレイク事例。現時点では人への感染報告がなく、地域当局による迅速な対応（殺処分、消毒、ワクチン計画）が実施されている。ベトナムはH5N1の常在地であり、異常性は低いが、人獣共通感染のリスク管理上、人への感染確認の続報を継続監視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Unknown Encephalitis in India: Health department enhances monitoring and response strategies
article.articleSummary: As of June 23, 2026, Kerala has reported 197 deaths from various infectious diseases, including 36 fatalities from amoebic meningitis and 15 from acute encephalitis syndrome (AES). The Kerala Health Department is intensifying surveillance efforts, mandating daily reporting from private hospitals due to a significant influx of patients, with 13,747 seeking treatment for fever. This year, the state has documented 159 confirmed dengue cases, 22 smallpox cases, and 241 cases of shigellosis, resulting in 7 deaths. The rise in meningitis deaths has doubled compared to last year, prompting urgent health responses. Additionally, the state has treated over 1.1 million fever cases, with ongoing concerns about the year-round prevalence of diseases like hepatitis A and chickenpox, which were previously seasonal. The proactive measures aim to enhance data collection and improve response strategies to manage the evolving health crisis effectively.

triage.headline_ja: インドの不明な脳炎：保健部門が監視と対応戦略を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク）。複数疾患の同時流行、高い死亡率（197死亡、特にアメーバ髄膜炎36例、AES 15例）、患者数の急増（13,747人の発熱患者）が報告されており、地域検証で確認された対象国インドでの対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケーラ州での複合感染症危機を報告。アメーバ髄膜炎の死亡数が昨年比で倍増し、AES（急性脳炎症候群）、デング熱、天然痘、シゲラ症が同時流行中。患者数が急増（13,747人の発熱患者）し、保健部門が民間病院からの日報を義務化するなど対応体制が強化されている。季節性疾患の周年化も懸念事項として報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Vietnam: Preventive measures essential as rainy season approaches
article.articleSummary: As of mid-June 2026, Vietnam has reported approximately 44,965 dengue cases and 5 deaths nationwide, with the southern region accounting for nearly 30,000 cases. In Dong Nai City, 2,461 cases have been recorded in the first four months of 2026, including 3 fatalities, with a notable increase in outbreaks documented at 870, up 22% from previous counts. The majority of cases involve individuals under 15 years old, while a concerning trend shows a shift towards adults aged 22-44. The Lam Dong Province has seen around 1,280 cases this year, a slight decrease from last year, with no deaths reported. Health authorities are actively managing 174 outbreaks and have initiated enhanced preventive measures, particularly as the rainy season begins, which creates ideal conditions for Aedes mosquito breeding. Efforts include improved surveillance, rapid response to outbreaks, and community education on eliminating standing water to mitigate transmission risks.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのデング熱：雨季が近づく中で予防策が重要
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで約44,965例のデング熱患者と5例の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準（異常性、深刻な公衆衛生への影響）を満たす。WPRO基準（重症度、流行しやすさ）も該当。
triage.notes: 2026年6月時点でベトナム全国で約45,000例の大規模なデング熱流行が報告されている。南部地域で30,000例近くが集中し、Dong Nai市では4ヶ月で2,461例（死亡3例）が記録されている。雨季の到来によりネッタイシマカの繁殖条件が整い、さらなる拡大のリスクがある。15歳未満の児童を中心とした患者発生が注目される。記事の主題国はベトナムのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1 in Vietnam: Ongoing efforts to control poultry outbreaks
article.articleSummary: In June 2026, an avian influenza A/H5N1 outbreak was confirmed in a backyard flock of 630 ducks in Tan Thoi Commune, Dong Thap Province, Vietnam. Symptoms were first observed on June 5, with RT-PCR confirmation on June 11. Of the 420 affected ducks, 230 died, prompting local authorities to cull 405 remaining birds to prevent further spread. No human cases have been reported as of June 24, 2026. The outbreak response includes extensive disinfection efforts, environmental cleansing, and plans for vaccination campaigns targeting over 90% of poultry in the affected area and 80% county-wide. Since early 2026, Vietnam has faced 37 poultry outbreaks across 11 provinces, resulting in the culling of over 206,500 birds, with Dong Thap among the provinces still experiencing active outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムにおけるヒトへの鳥インフルエンザA型H5N1感染：家禽アウトブレイク制御への継続的な取り組み
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常または予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」の2基準以上該当。ベトナムにおける複数地域での鳥インフルエンザH5N1の継続的なアウトブレイクであり、2026年初以来37件の家禽アウトブレイク（11州、20万6,500羽以上の家禽殺処分）が確認されており、ヒト感染のリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 鳥インフルエンザH5N1は高い病原性と国際的拡大リスクを持つ。記事では現時点でヒト感染は報告されていないが、複数地域での継続的な家禽アウトブレイク、大規模な家禽処分、ワクチン接種キャンペーン計画など、対応レベルの高さからフルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Japanese Encephalitis in India: Vaccination efforts amid rising fatalities and cases
article.articleSummary: In Assam, Japanese Encephalitis (JE) has resulted in 10 deaths and 42 confirmed cases this year, alongside 519 Acute Encephalitis Syndrome (AES) cases, which have led to 36 AES fatalities. The districts most affected include Kamrup, Barpeta, and Lakhimpur, with additional fatalities reported in Kamrup Metro, Cachar, and Jorhat. The case fatality rate for confirmed JE cases is approximately 30%. Preventive measures are being implemented, including extensive JE vaccination campaigns that have achieved over 85% coverage among targeted adults in several districts. The Health Department has trained 108 personnel for early identification and management of JE since February. The risk of infection is particularly high for paddy-field workers during the June to August period due to the presence of wild birds that can carry the virus. Public advisories have been issued to encourage protective clothing in affected areas, while fogging is used to control mosquito populations, although its excessive use raises ecological concerns.

triage.headline_ja: インドの日本脳炎：死亡率上昇と症例増加の中でのワクチン接種の取り組み
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の3項目（異常性、国際拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生影響）に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（30%の症例致命率、46死亡）と季節的な流行性が確認され、シグナルとしてフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 日本脳炎はWHO優先疾患であり、インドアッサム州での発生は毎年の季節的流行パターンだが、今年の死亡数（JE10名、AES36名）と症例数（JE42名、AES519名）は注視が必要。30%の症例致命率は高く、水田労働者への露出リスクが高い。ワクチン接種キャンペーン（85%カバー率）による対策進行中。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 in China: Monthly case counts raise concerns for public health
article.articleSummary: In June 2026, China reported over 20,000 confirmed COVID-19 cases for the month, with May alone accounting for 26,306 cases. Year-to-date totals have surpassed 100,000, although this figure remains significantly lower than the previous year. The recent uptick in cases has been attributed to a combination of respiratory illnesses, including influenza and rhinovirus, with COVID-19 showing a low-to-moderate presence. During the week of June 8–14, outpatient and emergency department positivity rates for COVID-19 reached 5.1%. Meanwhile, Taiwan's CDC has issued warnings regarding a potential summer wave of COVID-19, citing increasing global outbreaks as a significant threat. Vaccination rates among high-risk groups in Taiwan remain low, with only 21% of individuals aged 65 and older receiving their first dose and less than 0.5% receiving a second-dose booster. Public vaccination efforts are ongoing, with a deadline set for July 31. In Mainland China, May reported 35 severe cases and 1 death, mostly linked to Omicron, while Taiwan noted a 7% increase in domestic COVID-19 outpatient and emergency visits.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のCOVID-19：月次症例数が公衆衛生上の懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: スクリーニング基準（異常性・重症度・流行性）で複数該当するが、症例数が前年比で大幅に低下している点、重症化・死亡が限定的である点、および中国の対応能力が確立されている点から、即座のPICKUP判定に至らない。情報の更新・推移を注視すべき段階。
triage.notes: 記事は中国とタイワンの両方を扱っているが、タイワンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。中国での症例数は前年比で大幅に低下（年初来100,000超 vs 前年実績）、5月の重症化は35例・死亡1例と限定的。WPROスクリーニングでは「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」で該当するが、症例数低下傾向、重症度低い、管理可能性が高いという要因がWATCH判定を支持する。

article.articleHeadline: Enterovirus 71 in China: Vaccination and outbreaks highlight urgent health concerns
article.articleSummary: Enterovirus 71 (EV71) has led to significant Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease (HFMD) outbreaks in China, particularly in Guangdong, where approximately 28,000 cases were reported in May 2026. The illness primarily affects children, with symptoms including fever, sore throat, mouth ulcers, and rashes or blisters on hands and feet. Most patients recover within 7–10 days, but health experts warn of potential complications indicated by sleep disturbances. Vaccination is crucial, especially for children aged 6 to 71 months, with two types of EV71 vaccines available that show high efficacy against severe cases. The WHO endorses these vaccines, which have demonstrated a 94.6% efficacy rate against HFMD. Hygiene practices, such as thorough handwashing, are essential to prevent transmission, particularly in shared spaces. Travelers to Guangdong are advised to remain vigilant due to the ongoing outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のエンテロウイルス71：ワクチンと流行が緊急の健康上の懸念を強調
triage.triage_reason: エンテロウイルス71による手足口病の大規模流行（5月に約28,000例）が報告されており、IHR基準2項目以上（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）と、WPROスクリーニング基準複数項目が該当。旅行者への注意喚起も出ている。
triage.notes: 記事は中国（特に広東省）でのエンテロウイルス71による手足口病の大規模流行を報告。5月に約28,000例が報告されており、主に6～71ヶ月の幼児が対象。WHOが推奨するワクチン（94.6%有効性）の接種を強調し、渡航者への警告を発出している。複数の重篤化リスク指標（睡眠障害など）が記述されている。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis in India: Current trends and statistics on infectious diseases
article.articleSummary: As of June 23, 2026, Kerala has reported 1,531 cases of leptospirosis, resulting in 56 deaths, a decrease from 1,962 cases and 122 deaths in 2024. This decline is part of a broader trend where communicable diseases, including dengue and hepatitis A, remain below historical peaks. For the same period, dengue cases totaled 15,882 with 35 deaths, significantly lower than the 2017 peak of 88,322 cases. Hepatitis A cases also decreased to 9,436 with 36 deaths, down from 15,583 in 2025. Health Minister K Muraleedharan emphasized that except for Shigella, which has seen a notable increase, other communicable diseases have not surged compared to previous years, indicating effective public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: インドのレプトスピラ症：感染症の現在の傾向と統計

article.articleHeadline: Hepatitis A in India: Current trends and statistics on infectious diseases
article.articleSummary: In 2026, Kerala reported 9,436 cases of Hepatitis A, resulting in 36 deaths, a decrease from 15,583 cases and 45 deaths in 2025. This decline is part of a broader trend where communicable diseases, including dengue and leptospirosis, remain below historical peaks. For the same period, Kerala recorded 15,882 dengue cases and 35 deaths, significantly lower than the 2017 peak of 88,322 cases. Leptospirosis cases totaled 1,531 with 56 deaths, down from 1,962 cases and 122 deaths in 2024. Health Minister K Muraleedharan emphasized that except for Shigella, which has shown a notable increase, other communicable diseases have not escalated compared to previous years, indicating effective public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: インドにおけるA型肝炎：感染症の現在のトレンドと統計

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis in Indonesia: Enhanced collaboration boosts detection and treatment efforts

The initiative involved health workers conducting field education and case finding, which has been crucial in facilitating earlier treatment and reducing transmission rates. Officials emphasize that the increase in detected cases reflects improved diagnostic capabilities rather than a broader outbreak. The focus remains on rapid diagnosis and treatment to support the goal of eliminating pulmonary TB in the region.

article.articleHeadline: Listeria in China: Fresh-cut fruits identified as contamination hotspots
article.articleSummary: In 2024, China's National Center for Food Safety Risk Assessment reported that 3.21% of 218 fresh-cut fruit samples tested in Beijing contained pathogenic bacteria, including Listeria monocytogenes. A separate study in Shanghai revealed a concerning 13.85% contamination rate in fresh-cut watermelon, highlighting it as a significant risk factor. Contamination can occur without visible spoilage, leading to symptoms such as vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal cramps. The bacteria thrive at temperatures between 20–30°C, and cross-contamination from utensils is common. Experts recommend avoiding roadside pre-cut watermelons, thoroughly washing hands and cutting tools, and consuming smaller portions to mitigate risks. The WHO emphasizes that children under five are particularly vulnerable, facing a threefold increase in illness risk from unsafe food.

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Brazil: Effective municipal strategies lead to significant case reduction
article.articleSummary: In Sorocaba, Brazil, dengue cases have dramatically decreased, with only 62 laboratory-confirmed cases reported from January 1 to May 28, 2026, and no fatalities. This represents a greater than 99% reduction compared to the same period in 2025, which saw 13,151 cases and 22 deaths. The decline is attributed to proactive municipal actions aimed at prevention and vector control, including 241,785 visits by Zoonoses for breeding-site elimination and the removal of over 316,000 kg of potential mosquito habitats. Strategies implemented include systematic home inspections, adult mosquito control through nebulization, and targeted efforts in high-risk areas. These comprehensive measures not only address dengue but also other arboviruses such as Zika and chikungunya, showcasing the effectiveness of sustained public health initiatives.

article.articleSummary: Malaria cases in Kwilu Province, western Democratic Republic of Congo, have raised significant concerns among local health authorities. Clinicians have identified common malaria symptoms, including headaches, fever, abdominal pain, and vomiting, with several patients recovering after receiving treatment at local health centers. The Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB) has confirmed malaria diagnoses, and samples have been sent to Kinshasa for further verification. INRB Director Jean-Jacques Muyembe has reassured the public that the situation is not related to Ebola. A field team of ten health professionals is expected to arrive soon to collect more samples and evaluate the ongoing outbreak.

article.articleHeadline: Influenza in China: Rhinovirus infections peak during damp-heat season
article.articleSummary: Rhinovirus infections are currently prevalent in mainland China, particularly during the damp-heat season from May to June. In Shanghai, positivity rates for rhinovirus among outpatient and emergency room visits have ranged from 15% to 30% since late March. The virus typically has an incubation period of 1 to 3 days and primarily causes upper respiratory symptoms, with severe lung involvement being rare. Children, especially those under five and those with pre-existing conditions like asthma, are at increased risk for complications such as wheezing bronchitis. Most children recover within 7 to 10 days, but the absence of specific antiviral treatments necessitates supportive care. With over 160 subtypes of rhinovirus and short-lived immunity, reinfections are common, and no vaccine is available. Preventive measures emphasize hand hygiene and respiratory etiquette to mitigate transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Measles in Indonesia: Public health efforts focus on vaccination and education
article.articleSummary: As of June 17, 2026, Jambi City Health Office reports 612 confirmed measles cases and 681 suspected cases, indicating significant disease activity. The majority of cases are among children aged 5-9 years, with 213 cases, followed by 176 in the 2-4 age group and 157 in those over 10 years. Infants under 12 months are also affected, with 59 cases reported. Measles, characterized by high fever and a red rash, can lead to severe complications, including pneumonia and encephalitis. Due to budget constraints, not all cases undergo laboratory testing, leading to reliance on clinical diagnosis. Public health initiatives are underway, including patient treatment, contact tracing, and educational outreach to families. The Health Office emphasizes the importance of completing immunizations, particularly for children aged 9 months who have not yet received the measles vaccine.

article.articleHeadline: Varicella in Vietnam: Critical case underscores need for vaccination awareness
article.articleSummary: A 32-year-old unvaccinated man from Vĩnh Long experienced severe complications from varicella, including pneumonia, acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), liver inflammation, and coagulopathy. Following a rapid decline in health after contracting the virus, he was admitted to the ICU at Can Tho General Hospital. His condition deteriorated after initial treatment at a private facility failed, leading to intubation and extensive supportive care, including IV acyclovir and continuous renal replacement therapy. After nearly a month in intensive care, he was weaned off mechanical ventilation and transferred out of the ICU. This case highlights the potential for severe outcomes from varicella in adults and underscores the importance of vaccination, particularly as Vietnam moves towards implementing a two-dose vaccination strategy.

article.articleSummary: The burden of Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) is increasing among older adults in Vietnam, particularly as the population ages and chronic illnesses become more prevalent. Professor Phan Trong Lan emphasized the need for early recognition and preventive strategies, as RSV symptoms in older adults are often non-specific and under-recognized. The call for increased awareness and coordinated preventive measures was echoed by Dr. Wei Chih Chen and Pfizer Vietnam's Mark Kuo, stressing the importance of addressing this growing health concern in the region.

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis in Philippines: Health officials emphasize prevention amid increasing cases
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis cases in the Philippines increased by 6% from January 4 to June 6, 2026, compared to the same timeframe last year, according to the Department of Health. The disease is primarily transmitted through contact with floodwaters contaminated by animal urine, as well as through tainted food and drinks. Symptoms can manifest between 2 days to 4 weeks post-exposure, including fever, headache, muscle pains, red eyes, and dizziness. If left untreated, leptospirosis can lead to severe complications such as liver and kidney failure, and damage to the lungs or heart. The majority of cases are reported among farmers and individuals exposed to floodwaters or stagnant water following heavy rainfall. Public health officials are advising the community to wear protective boots in fields, wash any exposed skin with soap and clean water, and avoid contact with floodwaters, especially if there are open wounds. Prompt medical attention is recommended for anyone experiencing symptoms after exposure.

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya in Brazil: Economic impact and chronic pain challenges persist
article.articleSummary: Mato Grosso is grappling with a significant chikungunya outbreak, reporting over 50,000 probable cases last year. The Brazilian Health Ministry and OPAS/OMS have highlighted the ongoing spread of this arbovirus, which is linked to chronic pain issues that extend beyond three months. This persistent pain not only affects individuals' health but also severely disrupts workforce productivity, contributing to an estimated 5% loss in Brazil's GDP. Workers face income loss, increased risk of workplace accidents, and potential early retirement due to pain-related disabilities. The widespread use of analgesics without supervision raises concerns about gastric and renal damage, while minimally invasive pain relief techniques encounter stigma. To combat these challenges, prevention strategies recommend regular work breaks for stretching, and specialized care is available through Afya Educação Médica Cuiabá, offering various medical services to those affected.

article.articleHeadline: African Swine Fever in India: Containment measures implemented in affected regions
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of African Swine Fever (ASF) has been confirmed in Thahekhu Block-7, Dimapur district, Nagaland, leading to the declaration of an infected zone by the local administration. The Deputy Commissioner, Dr. Tinojongshi Chang, announced immediate containment measures in accordance with Government of India guidelines. Strict regulations are in place regarding the movement of pigs, piglets, pork, and related products in and out of the area. The Chief Veterinary Officer of Dimapur is tasked with conducting surveillance, sample collection, and necessary disinfection or culling procedures. Local police and authorities are assisting in enforcing these measures, while advisories are being issued to inform pig farmers and the public. All stakeholders in the affected area are required to comply with the containment protocols, which will remain in effect until further notice. No specific case counts have been reported at this time.

triage.headline_ja: インドのアフリカ豚熱：影響を受けた地域で封じ込め措置が実施される
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱は家畜動物への感染症であり公衆衛生上の直接的な重症度は限定的だが、地域レベルでの異常イベント（ナガランド州ディマプール地区での発生宣言）は確認される。情報が限定的（具体的な症例数・死亡数なし）であるため、動向確認が必要。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚熱は動物疾患であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の直接的な影響は限定的。地域行政による封じ込め宣言と政府ガイドラインに基づく対応措置が実施中。具体的な被影響家畜数や死亡数が報告されていないため、重症度の評価は不明。インド政府は対応能力を持つと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Human Metapneumovirus Infection in China: Monitoring trends in respiratory virus infections
article.articleSummary: As of June 24, 2026, the China CDC reports an upward trend in human metapneumovirus infections, particularly in northern provinces, amidst a backdrop of low overall influenza activity. Rhinovirus positivity remains the highest among outpatient influenza-like illnesses and hospitalized severe cases, with notable increases in southern regions. While influenza B is the dominant strain, parainfluenza virus positivity shows fluctuations, and enteroviruses are also on the rise. SARS-CoV-2 positivity has increased slightly but remains low. The public health response includes recommendations for mask-wearing in healthcare settings, protecting vulnerable populations, and ensuring good ventilation. Symptomatic relief for affected children includes saline nasal drops and humidification, as infections are typically self-limiting.

triage.headline_ja: 中国におけるヒトメタニューモウイルス感染症：呼吸器ウイルス感染動向の監視
triage.triage_reason: ヒトメタニューモウイルス感染の上昇傾向が報告されており、複数の呼吸器ウイルスが同時流行している状況だが、重症度や国際拡大リスクについては詳細が不明。情報が不足しているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 複数の呼吸器ウイルス（ライノウイルス、インフルエンザB、パラインフルエンザ、エンテロウイルス、SARS-CoV-2）が同時に流行している状況。中国CDC による監視が行われており政府対応が確認されている。ただし症例数、重症度、死亡数などの具体的な数値が記事に記載されていないため、真の重症度とIHR通知の必要性の判定が困難。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza B in China: Dominant strain amid low overall influenza activity
article.articleSummary: As of June 24, 2026, the China CDC reports that influenza B is the predominant strain circulating in the country, despite overall low influenza activity. Surveillance indicates that rhinovirus positivity is notably high among outpatient influenza-like illness and hospitalized severe cases, particularly in northern provinces. While parainfluenza virus positivity shows fluctuations, human metapneumovirus and enteroviruses are on the rise, especially in southern regions. SARS-CoV-2 positivity has also increased slightly over the past three weeks but remains low. Rhinovirus, primarily causing cold-like symptoms, is transmitted through droplets and contact, with infections typically resolving within a week. Public health recommendations include mask-wearing in healthcare settings, protecting vulnerable populations, and ensuring good ventilation.

triage.headline_ja: 中国におけるインフルエンザB：全体的なインフルエンザ活動が低い中での優勢株
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザB優勢株の報告であるが、記事では「全体的なインフルエンザ活動は低い」と明記されており、死亡数や入院患者の急増などの深刻性の指標が記載されていない。複数の呼吸器ウイルスが同時流行している点は注視が必要だが、現段階では情報不足のため経過観察段階と判定。
triage.notes: 記事は中国疾病対策センターの公式報告に基づいており、複数の呼吸器ウイルス（インフルエンザB、ライノウイルス、ヒトメタニューモウイルス、エンテロウイルス）の同時流行が報告されている。全体的なインフルエンザ活動が低いと明記されているため、現段階では重篤度の証拠が不足している。北部と南部で流行パターンが異なる点は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Varicella in Brazil: Health authorities enhance monitoring and preventive measures
article.articleSummary: Recent cases of varicella (chickenpox) in Carmo do Cajuru have prompted public health officials to issue a sanitary alert and intensify surveillance efforts. The first confirmed cases have led to increased vigilance as the disease spreads through direct contact and respiratory droplets. Symptoms typically include fever, malaise, headache, and intense itching, with contagiousness beginning 1-2 days before the rash appears and lasting until lesions crust over. Authorities are advising against the use of acetylsalicylic acid due to potential complications. Preventive measures focus on home isolation, hygiene practices, and medical evaluation at local health posts. Vaccination remains crucial, with the Brazilian Unified Health System (SUS) providing free two-dose childhood vaccination, including the tetraviral vaccine at 15 months and a second dose at four years. Health teams are set to expand monitoring and triage efforts, particularly targeting children to mitigate further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの水痘：保健当局が監視と予防措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: 水痘は予測可能な季節性疾患であり、局所的な集団発生の報告であるが、公衆衛生への深刻な影響や異常性は明確ではない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 水痘は高い感染力を有し流行しやすい疾患（WPRO基準1項目該当）。ブラジル保健当局は監視と予防措置を強化しており政府関心がある。しかし死亡例や重症例の報告がなく、予防接種プログラムが確立されているため、現段階では全般的リスクは低い。今後の症例数増加や重症化の報告が出た場合は判定見直しが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Meningococcal Meningitis in Brazil: Vaccination efforts strengthen public health response
article.articleSummary: In Cuiabá, Mato Grosso, Brazil, 17 confirmed cases of meningitis have been reported in 2026, resulting in 3 deaths. Notably, none of these cases are linked to meningococcal meningitis, and there is currently no circulation of this strain. The cases include 11 attributed to non-specified meningitis, 2 to cryptococcal meningitis (with 1 death), 2 to viral meningitis, and 1 each to Streptococcus pneumoniae and Staphylococcus meningitis. Among the patients, 11 have recovered, while 3 remain under surveillance. The local health authorities are actively reinforcing vaccination efforts across 72 health units, offering extended hours and home vaccination for individuals with comorbidities. The vaccination schedule includes MenC for infants at 3-5 months, a MenACWY booster at 12 months and again at 11-14 years, while MenB vaccination is available privately.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎：ワクチン接種の取り組みが公衆衛生対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: 記事サマリーに示されている通り、ブラジルの報告済み17件の髄膜炎症例のうち、髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎は0件であり、現在このウイルス株は流行していない。したがって、メインの病原体について国際的な拡大リスク、重症度の異常さ、予想外性のいずれも低い。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。また、記事の主題は髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の流行ではなく、予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンである。実際の髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎症例は報告されていないため、シグナルとしてのピックアップ対象にはならない。

article.articleSummary: In Mbuji-Mayi's central prison, a recent screening conducted by the Provincial Coordination of the National Tuberculosis Control Programme (PNLT) identified 82 confirmed cases of tuberculosis among inmates and staff. The initiative, lasting five days, aims to prevent further transmission by ensuring immediate medical care for those diagnosed. Dr. Marcel Kazadi, the provincial TB coordinator, highlighted the importance of rapid detection and treatment to protect the health of both inmates and prison staff.

triage.triage_reason: DRCの刑務所内で82例の結核確認例が検出され、192人中の高い陽性率は公衆衛生への重大な影響を示唆している。過密施設での結核管理は国家的課題であり、IHR基準2項目以上該当、WPRO基準複数該当のため、フルRRA進行推奨。
triage.notes: 刑務所という高リスク施設での集団感染検出。限定的な地理的スコープ（特定刑務所）だが、国家結核対策プログラムが介入していることから対応体制の存在を示す。医療資源の限定と過密環境が長期的曝露リスクを増加させている。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza B in Brazil: Child fatalities highlight urgent health concerns
article.articleSummary: As of June 24, 2026, Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, has reported 1,365 notifications of severe acute respiratory syndrome (SRAG) this year, with 819 confirmed cases and 102 deaths. Children under 10 years old account for approximately 68% of cases, totaling 928, which includes 420 infants under 1 year, 348 children aged 1–4 years, and 160 aged 5–9 years. The region has seen 14 child fatalities, with 4 under 1 year, 5 aged 1–4, and 5 aged 5–9, alongside three deaths in the 10–19 age group. Elderly individuals (60+) represent 73 of the total deaths, with 22 in those aged 80 and older. The etiological breakdown shows unspecified SRAG (442 cases), rhinovirus (256), respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) (248), Influenza A (109), and Influenza B (93). Preventive measures are being emphasized, including vaccination and hygiene practices, as a cold front is expected to increase transmission risk through June 25.

triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブラジルのマットグロッソドスル州カンポグランデでの複合呼吸器ウイルス流行を報告しており、インフルエンザBは93例と報告されているが、主要な公衆衛生上の懸念は複数病原体による重症急性呼吸器症候群（SRAG）の流行である。特に小児（全体の68%）と乳幼児における高い死亡率が注目される。寒冷前線による伝播リスク増加が指摘されており、進行中の流行である。

article.articleHeadline: Syphilis in China: Rising cases highlight urgent public health concerns
article.articleSummary: In Foshan, Guangdong, a 19-year-old man was diagnosed with secondary syphilis, presenting with severe hair loss and scalp lesions. Laboratory tests confirmed the diagnosis with a TPPA positive result and an RPR titer of 1:128. Secondary syphilis symptoms typically manifest 6 weeks to 6 months post-infection, including skin rashes and lymphadenopathy. The majority of syphilis cases, approximately 95–98%, are transmitted through direct contact, such as sexual activities and kissing, with condoms offering limited protection due to the small size of the causative agent, Treponema pallidum. Indirect transmission methods, including shared personal items and vertical transmission from mother to child, are also noted. The case emphasizes the critical need for early detection and treatment, as timely medical intervention can effectively cure most syphilis infections. This incident reflects a broader public health challenge, necessitating increased awareness and preventive measures in the community.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の梅毒: 増加する症例が緊急の公衆衛生上の懸念を浮き彫りにする
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の報告であり重症度は記載されているが、全国的な流行動向や死亡例などの具体的な疫学データが欠落している。スクリーニング基準は部分的に該当するが、本格的なRRA進行には追加情報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は単一症例（佛山市、広東省の19歳男性）の詳細報告であり、症例数の上昇傾向は示唆されているが「broader public health challenge」という表現にとどまる。全国規模での疫学的エビデンス（統計数値、流行曲線、死亡例など）が記載されていない。梅毒は性感染症として流行しやすく、二次梅毒の症状は明確に報告されているが、公式な当局の対応状況や緊急性判定の根拠が不透明。続報で全体的な流行状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: West Nile in India: Monsoon conditions exacerbate mosquito-borne illness risks
article.articleSummary: Kerala's monsoon season has led to increased cases of West Nile fever in Ernakulam, alongside rising Shigella infections and Nipah virus surveillance in Kozhikode. The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare and WHO highlight that monsoon conditions—characterized by water contamination, flooding, humidity, and sanitation disruptions—heighten the risk of transmission for these infectious diseases. While West Nile fever often remains asymptomatic, it can occasionally lead to severe neurological complications. Health authorities are urging the public to remain vigilant and seek timely medical assistance, emphasizing awareness over panic as multiple health threats emerge in the region.

triage.headline_ja: インドのウェストナイル熱：モンスーン条件が蚊媒介疾病のリスクを悪化させている

triage.notes: ウェストナイル熱に加え、シゲラ感染症とニパウイルスも同時に発生しており、複合的な感染症危機の様相を呈している。モンスーン季節による媒介蚊の増加と水環境の悪化により、短期的な急速な拡大リスクが存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria in Democratic Republic of the Congo: Recent outbreak highlights urgent treatment needs
article.articleSummary: A deadly malaria outbreak has emerged in Mukulubiala village, Bulungu territory, Kwilu Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 12 confirmed deaths since May 31, 2026. The National Institute of Biomedical Research (INRB) confirmed the illness as malaria, dispelling initial fears of Ebola virus disease. Several patients have recovered following antimalarial treatment. In response to the outbreak, there has been population displacement towards the Idiofa district as a precautionary measure. Initial samples were collected, with additional testing ongoing to confirm further cases. Symptoms reported include abdominal pain, vomiting, and fever, highlighting the endemic nature of malaria in the region and the critical need for effective control measures and timely medical intervention.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のマラリア：最近の流行は緊急の治療ニーズを強調
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：12死亡、異常/予想外：Ebola誤認、国際拡大リスク）。WPRO基準では重症度・流行性・管理可能性が該当。コンゴ民主共和国はフルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies in Thailand: Outbreak prompts urgent public health response
article.articleSummary: Nakhon Ratchasima is facing a rabies outbreak, with 20 infected dogs reported in the border districts of Mueang, including Huathalae, Nong Bu Sala, Pho Klang, and Nong Phai Lom. In response, local authorities have initiated a prevention and control program for 2026, mobilizing 220 health volunteers and partners. The program emphasizes responsible pet ownership, vaccination, and effective dog management. Volunteers feeding stray dogs are encouraged to incorporate preventive measures into their feeding practices and maintain cleanliness in their surroundings to help mitigate the risk of rabies transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) Infection in Vietnam: Addressing health challenges for aging populations
article.articleSummary: As of June 24, 2026, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is significantly impacting older adults in Vietnam and Southeast Asia, exacerbating chronic health conditions and leading to increased hospitalizations. The Vietnamese Preventive Medicine Association highlights the urgent need for awareness and proactive management of RSV, particularly as the region's population ages. Experts, including Prof Phan Trong Lân, stress that RSV is a serious health concern rather than a mild infection, especially for seniors with pre-existing conditions. Prof Wei Chih Chen points out that lifestyle factors, such as smoking, can further deteriorate respiratory health and worsen RSV outcomes. With projections indicating that the Asia-Pacific population aged 60 and over will reach approximately 1.3 billion by 2050, health systems are under growing pressure to implement early risk identification and preventive strategies to mitigate severe RSV impacts and maintain the independence of older adults.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムにおける呼吸器合胞体ウイルス（RSV）感染：高齢化する人口の健康課題への対応

triage.notes: RSVは季節性呼吸器感染症として既知の病原体であり、記事には「新規の異常」という要素が限定的である。しかし高齢化が急速に進むアジア太平洋地域における健康システムへの負荷増加、特にベトナムにおける入院数増加に対する公衆衛生上の関心の高まりは、引き続き監視対象とする価値がある。具体的な症例数、死亡数、地域的な流行拡大の程度についての追加情報が判定を高める可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Varicella in India: Public health challenges amid rising infectious diseases
article.articleSummary: As of June 23, 2026, Kerala, India, has reported 197 deaths from various infectious diseases this year, with significant concerns surrounding amoebic meningitis and shigellosis. The state has documented 139 cases of amoebic meningitis, resulting in 36 fatalities, while acute encephalitis syndrome (AES) has seen 73 cases and 15 deaths. Shigellosis has recorded 241 confirmed cases, leading to 7 deaths, with 165 cases and 6 deaths reported just this month. In total, government hospitals have treated over 1.1 million fever cases, including 882 cases of chickenpox and 3,737 cases of hepatitis A. Notably, deaths from chickenpox and hepatitis A have decreased to 27 each this year, compared to higher figures last year. The emergence of these diseases year-round, rather than seasonally, poses ongoing challenges for public health authorities in Kerala.

triage.headline_ja: インドの水痘：感染症増加に伴う公衆衛生上の課題
triage.triage_reason: 水痘単独では軽微だが、記事サマリーではアメーバ性髄膜炎、シゲラ症、急性脳炎症候群など複数の重篤な感染症が同時発生しており、死亡者数が多い点が懸念される。ただし、水痘と標題されながら実際の報道重点は複合感染症危機であり、情報の一貫性確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の見出しは『Varicella in India』だが、本文サマリーでは水痘（882例）が軽微で、むしろアメーバ性髄膜炎（139例、36死亡）、シゲラ症（241例、7死亡）、急性脳炎症候群（73例、15死亡）が主要な懸念となっている。複数の重篤感染症が同時発生し、年間197死亡が報告されている点でIHR基準を満たす。ただし詳細な疫学情報（検査確認、渡航リンク、根本原因）が不足しているため、WATCH段階とし、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Shigellosis in India: Public health challenges amid rising infectious diseases
article.articleSummary: As of June 23, 2026, Kerala, India, has reported 241 confirmed cases of Shigellosis, resulting in 7 deaths this year. The month of June alone accounted for 165 cases and 6 fatalities. The overall death toll from infectious diseases in the state has reached 197, with amoebic meningitis and acute encephalitis syndrome also contributing significantly to the health crisis. Meningitis cases have surged, with 139 reported and 36 deaths, while AES has seen 73 cases and 15 deaths. The state has treated over 1.1 million fever cases in government hospitals this year, highlighting the ongoing public health challenges. In contrast, deaths from chickenpox and hepatitis A have decreased compared to last year, indicating some progress in managing these diseases. However, the year-round occurrence of previously seasonal illnesses like hepatitis A, chickenpox, and dengue poses new challenges for public health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: インド：シゲラ菌症：上昇する感染症の中での公衆衛生上の課題
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大のリスク）。ケーラ州で241確定例と7死亡、6月の死亡率の上昇は著しい。複数の感染症の同時流行は公衆衛生危機を示唆する。
triage.notes: ケーラ州での複数感染症の同時流行（シゲラ菌症241例7死亡、髄膜炎139例36死亡、急性脳炎症候群73例15死亡）を報告。6月単月で165例6死亡と急増。政府病院での発熱患者110万例以上の治療。季節性疾患の周年化という新たな課題も指摘されている。これらの指標はWPRO基準の全5項目に該当し、複合危機と判定される。

locations.name: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

article.articleHeadline: Meningococcal Disease in Vietnam: Summer poses increased health risks for children
article.articleSummary: In Ho Chi Minh City, meningococcal disease is identified as a significant health risk for children during the summer months. The combination of hot, humid weather and increased travel to crowded areas heightens exposure to the disease, which can manifest as meningitis or septicemia. Initial symptoms include sudden high fever, headache, nausea, and a rapidly developing purpuric rash, potentially leading to severe complications such as septic shock and multi-organ failure if not treated promptly. The mortality rate can reach 50% without timely intervention, but with appropriate care, it drops to 5-15%. The disease spreads through direct contact with respiratory secretions, with an incubation period of 2-10 days. Vaccination is emphasized as the most effective preventive measure, with a quadrivalent vaccine available for children from 9 months old. Local pharmacies report an increase in vaccine demand, ensuring adequate supply and adherence to cold-chain protocols. Additional preventive measures include maintaining good hygiene practices and overall health.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの髄膜炎菌疾患：夏は子どもの健康リスクを高める
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでの髄膜炎菌疾患に関する季節的リスク警告だが、具体的な患者数・死亡数が記載されておらず、現在進行中の流行を示す明確な証拠が不足している。スクリーニング基準は複数該当するが、社会的・政治的関心の程度が不明なため。
triage.notes: 記事は季節的リスク警告として機能しており、髄膜炎菌疾患の病原性（致死率50%）と夏期における感染リスク増加を言及している。ただし、現在進行中の患者数、確認死亡数、ワクチン接種率などの具体的なエピデミオロジー情報が不足している。ホーチミン市の医薬品供給側からのワクチン需要増加が報告されているが、これが実際の患者数増加を反映しているのか、季節的予防啓発による需要増なのかは不明瞭である。続報での患者数・重症度データ確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Hemorrhagic Fever in Democratic Republic of the Congo: Cross-border transmission raises public health concerns
article.articleSummary: As of June 24, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing an ongoing outbreak of hemorrhagic fever caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant. This outbreak has prompted significant health concerns, particularly following the report of France's first Ebola case involving a physician who recently returned from the DRC. The patient is currently isolated, and contact tracing is underway, with health authorities assessing the risk to the general population as low. The absence of a vaccine or specific treatment for this variant underscores the urgency of effective surveillance and containment measures to prevent further spread, especially across borders. The situation highlights the critical need for international cooperation in managing infectious disease outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国での出血熱：国境を越えた感染伝播が公衆衛生上の懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による出血熱の発生とフランスへの患者渡航による国際拡大が既に確認されており、ワクチン未開発のため管理が困難。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus は既知の重篤なエボラ変異株。フランスへの患者輸入例が既に発生。ワクチン未開発、治療法なしの記載あり。国際的な関心と支援ニーズが高い。

locations.name: Ea Knop, Tinh GJak Lak, Vietnam

article.articleHeadline: Human Infection with Avian Influenza in Vietnam: Ongoing outbreaks prompt swift response and monitoring efforts
article.articleSummary: In Vietnam, recent outbreaks of H5N1 avian influenza have led to significant control measures. In Dong Thap, authorities confirmed the presence of the highly pathogenic strain on June 11, following the death of 230 ducks and subsequent culling of 420 infected French Muscovy ducks. Health monitoring for exposed handlers has been implemented, with no human infections reported thus far. The local government is actively conducting disease surveillance and vaccination campaigns, aiming for over 90% vaccination coverage among poultry in the affected areas. Meanwhile, in Dak Lak province, another outbreak resulted in the culling of hundreds of chickens, prompting similar vaccination and monitoring efforts. These actions are crucial to prevent further spread and potential human transmission of the virus.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムにおける鳥インフルエンザの人間感染：進行中のアウトブレイクが迅速な対応と監視活動を促進
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおけるH5N1高病原性株の複数地域での発生が確認され、鳥類への感染と制御措置が実施されている。現時点では人間感染報告なしだが、動物由来感染症の国際リスク潜在性とIHR基準適用の可能性から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、ベトナムのドンタップ省とダクラク省（Dak Lak）でH5N1高病原性株の鳥類アウトブレイクが確認されている。現時点では人間感染報告なしだが、動物疾病統制措置と監視強化が実施中。IHR基準では「異常/予想外」と「国際拡大リスク」の2項目が該当し、WPRO基準では4項目該当。ただし情報不足（重症度データ、旅行制限の具体的リスク）があるため、WATCH判定とし、人間感染報告の有無とベトナムにおける拡大状況の続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Unknown Illness in India
article.articleSummary: On June 24, 2026, seven inmates from Jharpada Special Jail in Bhubaneswar were hospitalized due to a mystery illness. Among them, three were critically ill and required ICU care, while two were later referred to AIIMS Bhubaneswar for advanced treatment. One inmate, identified as Maoist leader Rupu Singh, has since recovered and returned to jail. Authorities are investigating the cause, considering factors such as possible substance abuse and reactions to medication, but have found no evidence of food poisoning. The situation has prompted increased security measures at the hospital and a thorough examination of CCTV footage.

triage.headline_ja: インドの謎の病気 (Unknown Illness in India)
triage.triage_reason: 限定的な刑務所内集団発生（7名）で、原因が不明。重症度は中程度（3名が重篤、2名がAIIMS紹介）だが、現在のところ国際的拡大リスクや公衆衛生全体への深刻な影響の証拠がない。情報が限定的であり、原因特定のための続報が必要。
triage.notes: 刑務所内という限定的環境での集団発生で、記事では食中毒は除外されており、薬物乱用や医薬品への反応が検討されている。原因が不明なため、感染症か否か確実でない。個別の患者が回復して社会復帰しているため、急速な拡大リスクは低いと評価される。今後の原因特定と症例追跡の情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A in India: Current outbreaks and health challenges reported
article.articleSummary: Kerala is experiencing a significant outbreak of Influenza A(H1N1), with a confirmed death in Thrissur. Alongside this, dengue fever is spreading, with 159 confirmed cases reported on Tuesday and 295 individuals undergoing treatment for similar symptoms. The Palakkad district leads with 47 dengue confirmations, followed by Kozhikode (31), Ernakulam (24), and others. A death from dengue has been recorded in Malappuram, while a second death in Palakkad is under investigation. Other concurrent outbreaks include smallpox, chikungunya, and Shigella, adding to the public health concerns. Symptoms of dengue include high fever, severe headache, and rash, with critical warning signs necessitating immediate medical attention. The transmission of these diseases is primarily through mosquitoes, emphasizing the need for preventive measures and early treatment.

triage.headline_ja: インド：インフルエンザAの流行と保健課題が報告
triage.triage_reason: インドのケーラ州で複数の感染症（インフルエンザA(H1N1)、デング熱、天然痘、チクングニア、シゲラ）の同時多発的な流行が報告され、複数の死亡者が確認されている。IHR基準3項目（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、地域内での社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインフルエンザAを主題としているが、ケーラ州ではデング熱、天然痘、チクングニア、シゲラが同時に流行している複雑な公衆衛生危機を示唆している。複数の死亡者（インフルエンザA、デング熱）が報告されており、深刻性が高い。蚊媒介性疾患の流行にはベクター駆除などの環境的介入が必要となる。

article.articleHeadline: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) Infection in Thailand: Preventive strategies recommended for vulnerable populations
article.articleSummary: Thailand is experiencing a significant increase in Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) cases, nearing 50,000, particularly affecting children aged 0-4 years during the rainy season. Severe cases can lead to respiratory failure, necessitating ICU care and mechanical ventilation, with potential long-term respiratory issues such as chronic wheeze and increased asthma risk. To safeguard newborns amidst a declining birth rate, health experts recommend two key prevention strategies: maternal vaccination against RSV during pregnancy (24-36 weeks gestation) to transfer protective antibodies to infants, and the administration of a monoclonal antibody to provide immediate immunity for young children. This monoclonal antibody, which has been successfully used in over 50 countries, was introduced in Thailand last year and is shown to reduce hospitalization risk by over 80%. Parents are encouraged to consult healthcare professionals for tailored advice on these preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: タイのRSV感染症：脆弱な人口集団への予防戦略が推奨される
triage.triage_reason: タイでRSV感染症が約50,000例に近づく大幅な増加を記録し、特に0-4歳の子どもに影響を与えており、IHR基準（異常性、重篤性）を満たす。国内での公衆衛生上の重要な課題として識別される。
triage.notes: 記事はタイでのRSV感染症の明らかな流行を述べており、約50,000例の症例数、特に乳幼児への影響、重症化（ICU入院、機械的人工呼吸が必要）、および予防戦略の推奨が記載されている。妊娠中のワクチン接種とモノクローナル抗体療法といった具体的な公衆衛生対応が既に実施されており、政府の関心と対応が確認できる。

article.articleHeadline: Cholera in India: Monsoon conditions exacerbate waterborne disease outbreaks
article.articleSummary: India is currently facing a significant increase in gut infections, particularly cholera, driven by the monsoon season. High humidity, standing water, and temperature fluctuations create ideal conditions for the proliferation of bacteria and viruses. Contaminated water sources and unsafe food practices, such as consuming street food and unwashed produce, contribute to the spread of illness. From 2017 to 2023, nearly 4,400 waterborne disease outbreaks were reported, affecting over 200,000 individuals, with a notable peak during the monsoon months. Cholera outbreaks have been particularly severe from 2011 to 2020, with a marked increase in cases during June to September. Annually, approximately 37.7 million Indians suffer from waterborne diseases, leading to around 1.5 million diarrheal deaths among children. Heavy rainfall can compromise drinking water safety, necessitating boiling or filtering to ensure safety. Vulnerable populations include young children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with weakened immune systems. Effective prevention strategies focus on ensuring access to boiled or purified water and consuming freshly cooked meals.

triage.headline_ja: インドのコレラ：モンスーン時期が水系伝染病の流行を悪化させる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当。インド全域での恒常的で大規模な水系感染症流行、特にコレラの季節的悪化パターンが確立されており、脆弱集団への高い影響を伴う。
triage.notes: 記事はインド全域でのモンスーン関連水系感染症流行を主題としており、2017-2023年の4,400件の流行事例と200,000人以上の影響者数が記載されている。年間3,770万人のインド人が水系疾患に罹患し、年1.5百万人の小児下痢症死亡が報告されている。脆弱集団（幼児、高齢者、妊婦、免疫不全者）への高い脅威が明らかである。季節性に関わらず恒常的な公衆衛生危機として位置付けられるべき。

article.articleHeadline: Unknown Encephalitis in China: Rising cases linked to enteroviruses and school outbreaks
article.articleSummary: In Guangdong Province, China, Hand-Foot-Mouth Disease (HFMD) cases surged to 27,849 in May, with significant outbreaks reported in Shenzhen schools leading to class suspensions. The disease, primarily caused by enteroviruses like Coxsackievirus and Enterovirus 71 (EV71), poses severe risks, including meningitis and encephalitis. Transmission occurs through various routes, including respiratory secretions and contaminated surfaces, with the highest contagiousness during the initial week. Symptoms typically begin with fever and fatigue, progressing to painful mouth ulcers and rashes. Currently, there is no vaccine available, making prevention critical through rigorous hygiene practices, including thorough handwashing and disinfection. The situation highlights the urgent need for public health measures to control the spread of HFMD and protect vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: 中国での手足口病：エンテロウイルス関連の患者増加と学校集団発症
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性・予想外性、公衆衛生への影響）、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）、学校閉鎖を含む社会的関心の高さが確認される。
triage.notes: 記事の疾患名は「Unknown Encephalitis」であるが、サマリーの主題は手足口病（HFMD）である。広東省で5月に27,849症例に急増、深圳の学校で学級閉鎖を伴う集団発症が報告されており、エンテロウイルス71（EV71）を含むエンテロウイルスが原因とされている。髄膜炎および脳炎への進展リスクがあり、特に子どもの脆弱性が高い。ワクチンが利用不可のため、予防対策の強化が急務とされている。

article.articleHeadline: HIV in Indonesia: Pre-marital screenings reveal significant HIV cases
article.articleSummary: In Sidoarjo Regency, Indonesia, recent pre-marital health screenings have identified 22 prospective brides and grooms as HIV-positive. The local Health Department, Dinas Kesehatan, emphasizes that these screenings are crucial for protecting partners and future children, allowing for necessary planning to prevent mother-to-child transmission. The affected individuals are currently under medical surveillance and receiving regular antiretroviral therapy to manage their viral loads, alongside psychological counseling to support their mental health. Community education initiatives are underway to reduce stigma associated with HIV and encourage adherence to treatment. The Health Office is actively promoting screenings at local health facilities, which also test for syphilis and hepatitis B. Efforts are being made to validate the geographic distribution and age range of the cases for better epidemiological mapping in the region.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアのHIV：婚前検診で重大なHIV感染者が明らかに
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのシドアルジョ県で22人の新規HIV感染が検出されたケースだが、個別事例の検出であり国または地域全体への重大な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大のリスク、または渡航・貿易制限リスクを示すエビデンスが記事に明記されていない。情報不足のため継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア・シドアルジョ県での婚前検診時のHIV検出事例を報じている。WPRO基準では異常性（プレマリタルスクリーニングでの集団検出）、長期曝露リスク（HIV陽性者の継続的医療管理）、流行のしやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染病原体）の3項目に該当する。ただし、IHR基準での国際的拡大リスクや渡航・貿易制限リスクの記述がなく、また地域全体への重大な公衆衛生影響の具体的規模が不明であるため、フルRRA前の継続監視段階（WATCH）が適切と判定。地域での検査体制整備と管理可能性に関する追加情報の入手を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Unknown Illness in Indonesia
article.articleSummary: Recent reports from Indonesia indicate a concerning health risk associated with canned beverages due to potential bacterial infections linked to rat urine contamination. A notable case involved a man named Along, who died in 2025 after consuming an unwashed can, with doctors confirming the infection was caused by exposure to contaminants. In June 2026, two individuals fell ill after drinking from cans, prompting social media discussions about the presence of rats and urine on supermarket shelves. Nutritionist Siti Soraya emphasized that contamination can occur even on unopened cans, particularly if they have been stored for extended periods. She advised consumers to wash cans before use to mitigate risks, but warned that if contamination affects the beverage's interior or if the packaging is compromised, the drink should be discarded.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアにおける缶飲料のネズミ尿汚染による健康リスク
triage.triage_reason: ネズミ尿由来の細菌感染リスクとしては異常・予想外の事象であり、複数の患者発生が報告されているが、詳細な患者数・発症規模・病原体特定、および感染症の定義や伝播様式に関する情報が不足しているため。
triage.notes: 記事はネズミ尿汚染による健康被害を報告しているが、『Unknown Illness』として病原体が特定されていない。死亡例が2025年に報告されているが、2026年6月時点での新規発症は2例のみで規模は限定的。ただし継続的な曝露リスク（スーパーマーケットの棚の汚染）が存在し、公開討議も生じているため経過観察対象とすべき。より詳細な患者数、確定診断、流行状況の続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Scabies in China: Contagion concerns prompt urgent public health response
article.articleSummary: In Shenzhen, China, a family of five has been diagnosed with scabies, highlighting the disease's highly contagious nature. The initial misdiagnosis of eczema led to a delay in treatment for the affected family, particularly a child suffering from severe nocturnal itching. Scabies, caused by the mite Sarcoptes scabiei, is often confused with dermatitis but is characterized by specific symptoms such as itching in the finger webs, wrists, and other areas. Recent reports indicate a rise in scabies cases in Shenzhen, prompting health officials to advise close contacts to seek medical attention. Effective treatment involves antiparasitic therapy and thorough environmental disinfection, including washing clothing and bedding at high temperatures. Public health measures are being emphasized to control the spread of this condition, as awareness of its symptoms and transmission is crucial for prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 中国における疥癬：感染懸念が緊急公衆衛生対応を促す
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は一般的な皮膚感染症であり、局所的な家族クラスターの報告に過ぎない。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、または国際規制措置の根拠となる証拠がない。
triage.notes: 疥癬は既知の風土病であり、深圳市での家族クラスター（5人）の報告は公衆衛生上の重大事象の基準を満たしていない。診断遅延と治療対応は重要だが、IHR基準またはWPRO基準を満たす異常性や国際的リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Enterovirus 71 in Vietnam: Health officials warn of increased regional activity
article.articleSummary: Vietnam reported over 34,400 cases of Enterovirus 71 by April, with a notable increase in activity observed. The rise in cases has prompted health officials to issue warnings to travelers regarding hygiene practices while visiting Southeast Asia. In Taiwan, there has been a gradual increase in enterovirus activity, with outpatient visits rising by 2.4% in the latest week. Although no severe cases have been reported in Yunlin County, the local health bureau has suspended 83 classes as a precaution. Nationally, five lab-confirmed severe enterovirus infections have been documented this year, including one death. Symptoms of Enterovirus D68, which can include fever and respiratory issues, are being monitored closely, with an emphasis on hand hygiene to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのエンテロウイルス71：保健当局が地域活動の増加を警告
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおけるエンテロウイルス71の34,400症例超の報告と東南アジア地域での活動増加は異常・予想外であり、複数国での流行兆候が見られるため、IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当する。国際的拡大リスクおよび地域的な公衆衛生への影響が懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではベトナムでの34,400症例超の報告が主要な内容。台湾での活動増加も言及されているが、台湾は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ベトナムはWPRO地域における重要なシグナルとして位置付けられ、東南アジア地域での警告発出により国際的な関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies in Indonesia: Bali faces critical challenges in rabies control efforts
article.articleSummary: In the first half of 2026, Jembrana regency in Bali reported 33 confirmed rabies cases in animals, underscoring the ongoing threat of the disease. A recent incident on June 15 involved a rabid dog attacking a gathering, injuring a 47-year-old man and two children aged 5 and 4. The dog later exhibited rabies symptoms and died, with brain tests confirming the virus. Following this attack, the victims received post-exposure anti-rabies vaccinations. Additionally, a rabies-related death occurred on May 24 when a 38-year-old woman succumbed after being bitten by a stray cat, highlighting the critical need for timely medical intervention. Authorities are initiating a mass vaccination campaign for dogs and other animals in the vicinity of the attack. Bali remains one of Indonesia's most affected regions, with 16 rabies-related deaths reported in 2025 and five more in 2026. Rabies, while vaccine-preventable, poses a severe risk as it is nearly always fatal once symptoms appear, with dogs responsible for up to 99% of human cases.

article.articleHeadline: Paratyphoid in China: Increased vigilance needed for foodborne infections
article.articleSummary: In Zhejiang, China, a 9-month-old child was diagnosed with a Salmonella infection, presenting with high fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and rapid dehydration. This case highlights the seasonal peak of Salmonella infections during summer and autumn, attributed to dietary risks associated with undercooked foods and leftovers. Young children, particularly those under five, are more vulnerable due to lower gastric acidity and weaker immune systems. The incubation period for Salmonella ranges from 6 to 72 hours, with symptoms typically resolving within 3 to 7 days with appropriate home care. Medical attention is advised for severe symptoms, including persistent high fever, dehydration, and bloody stools. Preventive measures include thorough cooking, proper food storage, and good hygiene practices.

article.articleHeadline: Lyme in China: Fatal tick-borne infections raise health concerns
article.articleSummary: In June 2023, a 56-year-old man from Jixi, Heilongjiang Province, succumbed to severe complications following a tick bite. Initially presenting with high fever and altered mental status, he was hospitalized on June 9 but was not diagnosed until his transfer to Harbin Medical University First Hospital on June 10. Despite intensive care, he passed away on June 17. Medical evaluations indicated he suffered from both forest encephalitis and Lyme disease, conditions associated with tick bites. The hospital treatment, which included intravenous immunoglobulin, incurred costs exceeding 100,000 yuan. Tick-borne encephalitis, particularly prevalent in northeastern China during spring and summer, can lead to neuroinvasive infections, while Lyme disease may manifest with characteristic skin lesions and lymphadenopathy. The case underscores the health risks posed by ticks in outdoor environments, highlighting the need for increased awareness and preventive measures.

article.articleHeadline: Tick Borne Encephalitis in China: Fatal case highlights tick-borne disease risks
article.articleSummary: In June 2023, a 56-year-old man from Jixi, Heilongjiang Province, succumbed to complications from a tick bite, leading to a diagnosis of tick-borne encephalitis (TBE) and Lyme disease. After being bitten by a 'grass tick,' he experienced high fever and altered mental status, resulting in hospitalization on June 9. Despite initial misdiagnosis, he was transferred to Harbin Medical University First Hospital's ICU on June 10, where he received treatment including intravenous immunoglobulin. Unfortunately, he passed away on June 17, with hospital costs exceeding 100,000 yuan. TBE, a neuroinvasive infection prevalent in northeastern China, typically peaks in the spring and summer months, presenting symptoms such as fever, headache, and altered consciousness. The case underscores the significant health risks associated with tick bites in the region, particularly for those with outdoor exposure.
